stem: What is one similarity between the Harlem Renaissance of the 1920s and the Chicano Mural Movement of the 1960s and 1970s?

options.label: A
options.text: Both focused on the passage of anti-lynching laws.

options.label: B
options.text: Both secured rights for migrant farm workers.

options.label: C
options.text: Both generated cultural pride among minority groups.

options.label: D
options.text: Both worked to achieve suffrage for women.
